topic_title: Winter Driving Hazards, Bridges & Black Ice
prompt: Which essential survival items should be carried in a vehicle emergency kit during Texas winter travel?

options.text: Warm blankets, heavy clothing, flashlight, cell charger, scraper, sand or kitty litter
Extra cans of motor oil, car wax, spare windshield wiper arms, and chrome polish
Three spare full-sized automotive tires, tire irons, and two hydraulic jacks
Gasoline cans stored inside the enclosed passenger cabin for emergency fuel
